description:
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Forsaken Miner, targeting an opponent.
When you commit that crime, Forsaken Miner triggers, causing you to pay {1} to return it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Forsaken Miner enters, Mana Echoes triggers, adding {C} for each Skeleton and/or Rogue you control.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability.
Repeat.
